stock.description: Michong Metaverse (China) Holdings Group Limited functions as an investment holding company, primarily focused on providing network support and connectivity services across Malaysia. Its extensive service portfolio includes designing and installing network infrastructure, as well as offering network management and security solutions. Furthermore, the company delivers various connectivity options, such as intranet and internet solutions, complemented by value-added services. Founded in 2007, the firm was formerly recognized as Nomad Technologies Holdings Limited before adopting its current name in July 2022. Michong Metaverse is based in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
